subject: Architectural attestation: private & dedicated airlock validation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, security@finbank.com
Cc: audit@cleardata.io
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architectural attestation: private & dedicated airlock validation

Hi team,

Per FinBank's SIG/CAIQ follow-up, they asked for an explicit "airlock" validation narrative for our Private deployment option and how it differs from Dedicated. I pulled together an initial checklist of items they typically require:

- Control-plane isolation summary (what runs in customer VPC vs Redwood-managed control plane)
- Data egress controls and egress proofpoints
- Network ACLs, subnet zoning, and explicit port lists for cross-VPC proxies
- Tenant fencing and revocation runbook (eviction steps + verification)
- Evidence artifacts (diagram, segmentation matrix, test logs)

Can Kimberly/Tessa confirm who owns each artifact and whether the airlock diagram attached reflects the current on-prem/private packaging? I suggest we include a short validation note describing how we executed a fumigation test (simulated tenant eviction) in staging.

Thanks,
Karthik
Engineering Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (referenced) redwood_airlock_diagram_v2.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, security@finbank.com
Cc: audit@cleardata.io
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architectural attestation: private & dedicated airlock validation

Karthik / Team,

Thanks — good outline. Quick clarifications to make the response consumable for auditors at FinBank:

1) One-page control summary (I will draft): short bullets for control-plane, data-plane, and key management boundaries.
2) Updated diagram (attached): shows both Private (customer VPC with access proxies) and Dedicated (Redwood-hosted GPU pool + tenant overlay).
3) Segmentation matrix (Tessa to own): mapping of feature x control, expected evidence type, and sample artifact.
4) Fumigation test note (Karthik to provide): steps run, expected verification, sample logs.

Tessa — can you create the segmentation matrix spreadsheet and add a column with the CAIQ/SIG question IDs we are addressing? Aim to have first draft by EOD Wednesday.

FinBank / ClearData — if there are any specific diagramnotations you need (e.g., route tables, explicit proxy ports, or KMS boundary callouts), let us know and we'll include them in the attestation packet.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Security Architecture
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_airlock_diagram_v2.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, security@finbank.com
Cc: audit@cleardata.io
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architectural attestation: private & dedicated airlock validation

Kimberly / Karthik / FinBank,

Segmentation matrix (attached) — first pass completed. Highlights:

- Control categories mapped: Control Plane, Data Plane, Key Mgmt, Monitoring/Telemetry, Eviction/Remediation.
- Evidence types: diagram, policy snippet, test log, playbook excerpt.
- Private vs Dedicated differences called out:
  * Private: customer VPC runs inference nodes; Redwood control-plane connectors are restricted egress-only tunnels; KMS optionally customer-managed.
  * Dedicated: GPU pools reside in Redwood-managed tenant-isolated infrastructure with dedicated GPU nodes; stricter SLAs but shared control-plane components.

Open asks for FinBank:
- Do you require HSM-backed KMS (customer-provided) or will Cloud KMS be acceptable for Private?
- Preferred format for the fumigation logs (CSV vs zipped JSON)?

I attached segmentation_matrix_finbank.xlsx and added a column mapping to CAIQ v4 question ids where applicable. Will add the playbook excerpt and sample logs in the next update (target Thu EOD).

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: segmentation_matrix_finbank.xlsx

From: ClearData Audit <audit@cleardata.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, security@finbank.com
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architectural attestation: private & dedicated airlock validation

Kimberly / Tessa / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts — the diagram and matrix look promising at a glance. A couple of requests before we mark this "attestation-ready":

- Please include a short one-paragraph attestation statement, signed by a technical lead, confirming the fumigation test execution date, the environment used (staging vs prod-sim), and the log retention window for the evidence bundle.
- For Private deployments, call out the exact egress proxy FQDNs and the minimum ephemeral port ranges used (auditor requirement for firewall rule verification).
- Provide a sample truncated fumigation log (redacted) in CSV and the evidence_manifest_20261119.csv that indexes each artifact and its hash.

If you can deliver those items early next week we'll route through FinBank's compliance intake and close the SIG control mapping.

Best regards,
Ellen Park
Senior Auditor
ClearData Audit

Attachments requested: evidence_manifest_20261119.csv (index), sample_redacted_fumigation_logs.csv
